notes.title: 《长安：石之舞》8月新版本更新公告
notes.notes: [p]各位殿下早上好！[/p][p]上次产品发布后至今，我们也通过Steam、玩家群、社交平台等渠道，收到了大家很多中肯的反馈，这对开发组来说是无比珍贵的，非常感谢各位殿下对《长安：石之舞》的热爱。[/p][p]结合大家反馈中呼声较高的意见，开发组在多次讨论后，决定在近几个月中对版本进行一些重大更新，既有原有系统的优化调整，也有不少新增内容。时隔数月，今天终于可以呈现给大家，请喜爱肉鸽的殿下们多品鉴指正！[/p][p]这次更新主要包括了补充局外成长、战前自由搭配、BD随机性保护、流派终极形态爽感提升，性能优化和稳定，平衡各流派数值，减弱重复感等等。[/p][p]本次版本新增包括：[/p][p]1、	新增天赋系统：将原有等级带来的固定养成，变成可以在局外自由搭配的天赋树，使局外养成有更多主动选择权。[/p][p]2、	新增魄藏系统：在展示七魄图鉴的同时，允许战前自主进行ban魄操作。[/p][p]3、	新增遗物重铸系统：可以在局内通过重铸遗物随机搭配想要的流派属性，使局内变化更丰富自主。[/p][p]4、	新增全流派终极形态：更新全部流派终极形态，确保每系BD有可追求的终结形态，同时完成魄数值和词条的调整，增加流派搭配推荐等内容。[/p][p]5、	新增难度：新增四难度-归玄，并在四难度通关后，增加可以无限挑战的无尽关卡“苦海”，提升局内挑战的体验深度。[/p][p]6、	新增多结局：包含4个正传结局+4个后续结局+2个隐藏结局，给到玩家更多体验内容。同时，剧情选项按钮增加命簿提示，明确告知多结局达成路径。[/p][p]7、	新增游戏指南：可以随时在指南中查看游戏玩法介绍。[/p][p]优化内容包括：[/p][p]1、	 魂册系统优化：调整了魂册系统开放内容，同时增加了ban魂的操作空间。[/p][p]2、	交互优化：魂装配界面交互、命薄系统UI优化，降低游戏上手难度和理解成本。[/p][p]3、	关卡优化：配合局内外养成节奏，修改关卡怪物的属性，优化关卡链路长度，使关卡体验感受更流畅。[/p][p]4、	手感优化：针对部分流派操作手感不好的问题，进行了深度优化，并增加了冲刺普攻、蓄力转向等细节操作。[/p][p]5、	性能优化：解决BD终极时的卡顿问题，同时更新流派大招音效。[/p][p]受限于人力和时间，我们对于游戏的优化还没有做到最好。但我们仍然会尽最大努力听取大家反馈，完善我们的游戏。[/p][p]希望这次更新能给各位殿下带来一个不一样的版本，体验到有不一样的感受，开发组也会持续倾听大家的声音！ 有任何想法或建议，欢迎随时通过官方渠道反馈！	[/p][p]感谢各位一路以来的陪伴与支持！让我们共同见证游戏的蜕变！[/p]

notes.title: Daily Update On June 25

When the number of peaches is full, any additional peaches will be automatically used.

Fixed issues where some endings had missing characters or incorrect spacing display.

notes.title: Daily Update On June 16

Bug Fixes:

notes.title: June 12 Daily Update
notes.notes:
Experience Optimization
※ Added group execution mechanism: When executing a target, all executable enemies within 15 meters of the target will be killed simultaneously. Healing and mana restoration are calculated based on the number of executed targets.
※ Reduced the kill value requirement for shield events in difficulty 3.
※ Optimized the enemy placement in the L-shaped room of level 3, where a shielded enemy was previously positioned unreasonably.
※ Improved the damage text trembling effect to better follow target movement.
※ Adjusted the execution bar mechanic: Instead of dropping to 0 instantly when full, it now gradually decreases over time and continues increasing after attacks.
※ Added BUFF icon display for MBTI attributes, allowing players to view in-game MBTI property gains.

Bug Fixes
※ Fixed the occasional UI pop-up closure issue where certain interfaces could not be closed.
※ Resolved the execution failure issue when targets were present but could not be executed.
※ Fixed the execution block issue for shielded enemies and their split variants.
※ Addressed the NPC damage issue caused by lightning chain effects.
※ Optimized room reward rules for consistency and fairness.

notes.title: Update Announcement on June 9:
notes.notes: ※[Hotfix] Fixed a bug where shielded enemies on Difficulty III were unable to be executed.

Corrected an issue where Fire, Metal, and Water element weapons' second dash combos did not apply higher-probability special element effects.

Resolved an issue where summoned creatures' HP and max HP could not be inherited properly.

Improved Soul Effect descriptions.

notes.title: June 7th Daily Update Log:

notes.title: Update Announcement on June 4
notes.notes:
**Experience Optimization (Story Mode Type, Controller Vibration, Combat Class Tuning, Overall Optimization):**
※  A new controller vibration feature has been added to optimize impact feedback. Currently, it is integrated with two weapons: the Mo Dao and the Leg Blade. The intensity of the vibration can be adjusted and turned off in the settings panel according to personal preference. Over the next two days, we will add vibration feedback for the War Drum and optimize the vibration experience for the Mo Dao and Leg Blade based on player feedback.
※  A new combat difficulty option has been added in the settings, allowing players to switch at any time. After switching, the "Phantom Walk" difficulty will significantly increase initial attributes to help new players become familiar with the game.
※ A new story frequency option is now available in the settings, allowing for easy switching. After switching, the chance of encountering "Remembrance" doubles, enabling players who prefer the storyline to collect content more quickly.
※  The generation of spirits from certain spikes has been optimized to occur beneath the most recent enemy target.
※  Optimized the performance of the Qiantang Dragon Lord under Weapon 2, with randomly generated drums prioritizing throws towards the nearest enemy target.
※  When players of the Water Element cast the Celestial Soul skill, the Celestial Soul skill will also be duplicated.
※  Optimized Li Jing so that summoning treasures no longer requires the consumption of spirit.
※  Added a cutscene to mark the beginning of Chapter 3.
※  In the Remembrance where fireworks are exchanged for the Mo Dao, the required number of fireworks has been changed from 30 to 10.
※  The reward room for the three-choice bonus has been changed to allow the selection of relics. (This optimization for relics is temporary for today; in the future, we will allow multiple selections for relics to give players more choices, and we will also optimize the display of relics to make obtaining and viewing them clearer).

**Bug Fixes:**
※  Fixed an issue where the calculations for lunar phases and remembrance refreshing could become disordered under special circumstances.
※  Fixed a sporadic issue where room rewards would not refresh.
※  Fixed a combat freeze issue that occurred after a wood-type build was established.
※  Corrected an issue where the poison mist from the poison class appeared to float in the air.

notes.title: June 3 Daily Update2
notes.notes:
Experience Optimizations
Significantly increased the trigger probability of secondary souls for Thunder, Wind, and Metal Fusion Souls after activation.
Walls: Duanlong Zha, Jinguo Gu, and Shulie Bei now have a 5-second duration instead of activating only on the next damage instance.
Wind Basic Attack gains an additional effect: each attack grants 1 layer of Critical Rate, lasting 1.5 seconds, with a maximum of 50 stacks.
Optimized recovery time for Wind Mo Dao and Wind Tu Ren after stopping, improving responsiveness for reactivation.
Improved descriptions for Fire Souls and other health-regeneration-related Souls to enhance readability.
Revised narrative content for Yuan Niang, Empress, Senior Brother, Sasha, and Younger Brother in their side stories.
Fixed a bug where the third-floor Sorcerer Room lacked a next-stage entrance after completion.
BUG Fixes
Achievement completion issues (e.g., level milestones, enemy kills, jar destruction) can now be triggered upon re-entering the game for affected players.
Fixed abnormal effects for offerings: Cang Sheng Ge, Jin Cuo Dao, and Sheng Yan Pi Dan.
Fixed the "Ji · Wu Ming Jin" skill not taking effect without restarting the game.
Improved chain lightning efficiency for Water Formation + Thunder Variation.
Corrected descriptions and effects for Wind Formation + Metal/Terrain Variations and Fire Formation + Metal/Terrain Variations.
Fixed the issue where Zhuang Zhou did not immediately align with the mouse direction when firing butterflies.
Corrected the naming inconsistency for Water-Phase Series Souls (previously unrelated to the Water Element).
Fixed the discrepancy between Guan Yu Soul's charged effect range and its visual charge animation.
Aligned the direction of the "Longbo" Wood Drum's visual effect with its actual damage direction.
Fixed the "Yue · Hui Wang Shu" skill not triggering collision damage against unbreakable-defense targets.
Attempted to resolve the "Qiantang Long Jun" skill's late-game damage issue, though the root cause remains uncertain (currently unreproducible).
Updated the description for "Chuiyi" unlock requirements: changed from 4 fragments to 3 fragments to unlock offerings.
Fixed a loophole where exiting the game could reset free refresh attempts in the Soul Selection Interface.
Fixed bugs in specific story rooms (e.g., Gao Xianzhi · Chong Niang Cheng Lou Fang, Senior Brother · Shan Zhe Wang Yu Zhu), including incorrect animations.

notes.title: June 3 Daily Update
notes.notes:

Story-based Room Trigger Mechanism: Changed from calculating "Life Ashes" count to a weighted random selection based on level progress.
Lunar Phase Gameplay Activation Timing: Postponed to later stages.
Lunar Phase Transition Frequency: Reduced by 20%, making it less disruptive during combat.
Life Ashes Usage: No longer trigger story rooms. Instead, they can now be manually exchanged at the Spirit Platform with Yuan Niang.

notes.title: May 29 Daily Update
notes.notes:
**Experience Improvements:**  
※ Adjusted mana restoration mechanics: Killing enemies now grants additional mana, with increased attack-based mana regeneration for smoother talisman and array gameplay.  
※ Reduced **Blood Orb Matriarch**'s HP and shield values in Chapter 2 for quicker combat resolution.

※ Fixed multiple bond effect mismatches in skill tooltips.

※ Rectified text errors in select offering descriptions.

notes.title: 5月28日更新公告
notes.notes:
各位殿下晚上好，循例继续为大家奉上开发组今日的努力优化成果！
希望殿下们给游戏多提意见，开发组会更努力的让石之舞变得更好玩！


[b]体验优化：[/b]
※ 【多结局】为解决剧情结局变化稳定，很难出其他结局的问题，将命薄改为单局结算，同时大幅增加命簿相关异闻录的集齐属性。
※ 提升雷阵法的稳定性，雷圈加移速，并且随着雷阵等级提高，阵法移动速度大幅增加。
※ 木阵法释放期间的减伤效果，改为无敌。
※ 土系阵法可以围住怪物，使得怪物无法冲刺出城墙范围。
※ 结算界面加命薄按钮。
※ 桃初始数量增加为2，初始上限改为3，部分等级提升可以获得桃的上限增加。
※ 魂魄总览查看界面优化，让内容更清晰。

[b]BUG修复：[/b]
※ 修改百鬼夜行开启后可能导致无法继续游戏的bug。
※ 修复传送门缺少图标问题。
※ 修复进入月相后斩杀的滤镜表现错误问题。
※ 修复灵龛界面Hover状态错误。
※ 修改部分错别字。
※ 添加保护，尝试修复偶现问题，处决对象太多导致怪物卡住。
※ 增加一层cd保护，尝试修复安神罩内地火炸弹无限增加，导致直接特别卡的问题。

notes.title: 5月27日游戏更新说明
notes.notes:
各位殿下们晚上好，今天的开发组依然在紧锣密鼓的优化游戏！你们的意见我们都有听到！

这就为大家送上今日份更新：

体验优化： 

1.删除月相更新影响战斗感受的黑白效果。

 2.修改蛾眉殇答题文本，增加提示性文字，并在过程loading中增加部分答案。 

3. 修改月相提示，在扣血前都能知道本次是月相的玩法类型。 

4. 修改选武器时选项的顺序。 

5.优化追忆开始前的黑屏字幕重复且不可跳过的问题。 

6.新增受击/相机抖动开启关闭的接口，头晕的玩家有福音了。 

7.魄投放流派升级，增加随机规则保护，更容易出现自己想要升级的魄。 

8.优化异闻录投放魄的体验，让大家更容易拿到。

 9.部分灵掉落物的延时进包时间太久，加快进包时间。 

10.优化带鱼屏显示。 

11.优化背包临时道具的动态时限显示，现在可以显示效果可以持续多少个房间。

 12..优化过关统计显示。

 

Bug修复： 

1.错过二三难度领取难度首通供品奖励的家人们，上线后会补发没拾取的供品。 

2.修复部分玩家多结局异闻录投放丢失的Bug。 

3.帧率设置失效修复，可以设置120帧生效了。 

4.修复在挑战房因刷茧拿奖励，而导致无法进入下一关的bug。 

5.局内返回大厅增加手动确定，避免误操作离开。

notes.title: 来自长安：石之舞的一封信
notes.notes:
各位玩家，大家好！
我们是疯批动作肉鸽游戏《长安：石之舞》的制作团队，当你们看到这封信，意味着这款产品将很快在Steam开启试玩，正式与大家见面了，希望试玩阶段的品质能让大家满意！也诚挚地期望大家届时能多提供宝贵的意见，让我们一起打造一款超疯批的国风肉鸽游戏吧。

我们的团队可能还不够成熟，但我们完全相信，通过吸收大家的反馈，和我们持续的打磨，会让这款肉鸽游戏体验变得更好玩。也希望大家能够给予我们一些成长的时间，把石之舞做的更好玩！

[h3]【欢迎来到盛唐阴影下的小国】[/h3]
盛唐是一个令人浮想联翩的朝代。
他的兴盛众所周知，但又是什么原因，让王朝在数十年间快速衰落？天宝年间发生的一系列大事，是否有所关联？期间那么多文人骚客、将相英雄们都经历了什么？那些归附在盛唐下的西域小国，又在不经意间，发生了多少鲜为人知的故事？

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439416/b6ce2386966e4bbc284a5c139a8f255e38e320a2.jpg[/img]

我们在星星点点的历史中，收获了许多灵感，主文案将这些灵感串在一起，发掘出了一段很有想象力的故事。《长安：石之舞》这款游戏会作为载体，代替我们把这个斑斓的想象呈现给大家。

这个很长的故事，故事要从高仙芝灭石国讲起，聚光灯给到一位出生在石国的公主。小时候，她被要求丢弃玩具，迫害侍女，击杀宠物，善良的她面对这些事手足无措；长大后，她为爱情出逃城外，以真心换宝刀送给情郎，然而高仙芝却在利用完她的纯真后将其灭族毒杀。游戏中，我们将扮演重生一次的公主，面对种种重新做出选择，重生完成复仇，并接触到李淳风与安禄山各自的谋划，将唐传奇的故事一层一层揭开。

可以是【弱女子反PUA黑化成长日记】，也可以是【人性的光芒终将驱散牛鬼蛇神】；无论如何，那都将是我们自己在游戏里的选择，我们会以自己的样子去经历这个故事。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439416/faee4ab9b9da8250d39c8352218a380ee4741a30.jpg[/img]

关于讲故事的方式，相比于铺设一个宏大的世界观，我们更喜欢将一两个人物讲的鲜活，以此推动剧情的发展。相比于大段的信息推送，我们更希望玩家用体验的方式，获得剧情，联想剧情。

在游戏中，我们会用舞台剧的方式，将一个个故事切片中激烈的冲突或者强烈的情感下表达呈现。用碎片化的方式让玩家在成长的同时获得信息，让感兴趣的的玩家有发现剧情的体验，不感兴趣的玩家也能够尽情享受流畅的战斗体验，和丰富且深度的战斗构筑。

因此，我们设计了剧情房来讲公主线的故事，设计了异闻录来补全故事的背景和彩蛋。我们非常期望公主的成长能在其复仇方式上有所关联，于是我们在公主经历剧情房的选择时，使用类日记的形式把公主的选择记录下来，根据累积的选择给公主不同战斗道具的奖励；我们还会把公主的选择转化为公主累积属性的成长，是一个暴力的公主，还是一个生存力很强的公主，期待你们在游戏中的选择。

[h3]【低头赶路，挥刀向前】[/h3]
进入这个世界，你将邂逅唐代民俗中的传奇角色，获得他们的帮助。公主可以与他们互动，继承以及融合他们的能力，激活你的五行法阵，通过搭配你的武器、贡品和魂魄，一步步走向重生。

当然我们还设计了更多寂寂无名的市井人物。诸如贩夫走卒、商贾艺人、官僚书生等等……他们是盛唐里描绘更少，但更鲜活的存在。这大唐繁华之下的群像故事，将在你的探索下逐一揭开。

镜中孽海空花，前尘故人再现，魑魅魍魉痴缠，志怪谜局不断……
